environment: Roblox Studio isolated Server (ProfileStore) and Edit (final server/shutdown suites) execute_luau
scope: Actual current source with fake DataStore, players, clocks and shutdown scheduler

checks: Studio progression never contacts a DataStore
Published profile acquires an exclusive owner lease
Malformed stored numbers are sanitized and star totals are recomputed
Malformed daily records cannot introduce non-finite scores
A second live session cannot steal an unexpired real-epoch lease
A contended blank profile cannot overwrite durable progress
UpdateAsync callback retries do not duplicate XP or completions
Repeated autosaves are idempotent
A failed save preserves the last durable profile
A later autosave recovers from a transient failure
An expired abandoned lease can be safely acquired without losing progress
A stale owner cannot overwrite a newly acquired session
Release saves the final profile and removes ownership
A released profile loads immediately into another session
A failed initial load never writes a default profile over saved data
Fast rejoin retries a departing lease and loads the durable profile
Persistent contention has a bounded retry budget and never steals ownership
Release arriving during autosave writes a fresh final snapshot and releases the lease
Departure during an in-flight load releases a newly acquired lease immediately
A departed player never starts a new profile claim
A transient load outage recovers within the bounded loading window
Async profile loading blocks every progression start and reward path
Invalid ingredients, premature serve and empty bake rejected
Non-finite oven input rejected
Practice completes through real scoring module
Active oven control improves baking over idle power
One chef waits without starting
Second chef starts countdown
Leaving countdown cancels it
Two chefs share recipe, start and deadline
Late arrival queues without entering current round
Active participant cannot switch modes to evade round
Serving locks result while another chef remains active
Deadline scores unfinished pizza zero and declares correct winner
Queued chef enters fresh room after results interval
Completed standings persist after live room resets
Next competition starts independently
Disconnect forfeits without blocking remaining chef
Deadline auto-serves ready pizza and excludes forfeited chef
Battle replay queues with accurate membership
Queued chef can cancel cleanly
New profile is playable and honestly session-only in Studio
Career shift starts with one timed server-selected order
NextOrder cannot skip an unfinished order
Successful career pizza earns stars XP personal best and one completed order
Repeated Serve cannot duplicate XP or shift credit
NextOrder advances once and introduces the stronger oven challenge
Unfinished career order times out without XP and resets only the shift combo
Final shift order has a clear shorter deadline
Three orders finish the shift and preserve the aggregate personal best
A finished shift cannot advance or grant its completion reward twice
A worse replay never erases earned stars or personal records
Different players receive the same daily challenge
Daily personal best is independent of a perfect practice recipe record
First daily target clear grants the documented bonus once
Repeated daily challenge compares against its own earlier daily score
Daily replays keep normal XP without farming the daily or contract bonus
A new UTC day enables one new daily bonus
Career chefs can return to a fair battle room
New career modes cannot evade an active battle
Forfeiting a battle grants no progression reward
Career recipe pool remains fixed through shift order 1
Career recipe pool remains fixed through shift order 2
Career recipe pool remains fixed through shift order 3
A mid-shift rank increase does not change the current shift pool
Three excellent career orders form a three-pizza session combo
Returning to the menu preserves the earned session combo
A new shift continues the session combo
Five-pizza combo achievement is reachable across successive shifts
Shutdown freezes both automatic deadline rewards and remote gameplay before final snapshots
PlayerRemoving removes gameplay state but retains a pending final-save registry entry
Last-player shutdown waits for an already-departing profile final save
Shutdown waits through an in-flight autosave then persists the latest final progress
A transient final-save failure is retried while shutdown is waiting
